purpose: Per-identity threshold calibration on the frozen E65 baseline scorer (E221 pipeline). Only thresholds change; no new representation or head is trained.

candidates.name: global_tau
candidates.note: E221 reproduction: tau = 10% quantile of all enrolled inner-OOF known scores.

candidates.name: per_subject_tau
candidates.note: tau_i = 10% quantile of subject i inner-OOF known scores (all tasks pooled). Applied with the predicted identity.

candidates.name: per_subject_task_tau
candidates.note: tau_{i,t} = 10% quantile of subject i, task t inner-OOF known scores; if n<30 rows fall back to tau_i.

candidates.name: per_subject_tau_shrunk
candidates.note: tau_i = 0.5 * subject_i_quantile + 0.5 * global_quantile (w fixed in config).

reference_e65_baseline.source: E221/E222/E223 frozen baseline (E65 PCA96 k12, global tau)

freeze_rule: Freeze a per-identity calibrated candidate only if LOSO unknown rejection > 0.90 AND Test S2 acceptance >= 0.70 AND Test S1 rejection >= 0.70. Test is read once, after all thresholds are constructed from Train only.
selection: All candidates and parameters are fixed before the run. No Test-based selection. Test is used only for uniform evaluation and for the pre-declared freeze check.
